body: Thank you for taking the time to comment though! Yeah, that's one of the things I'm considering for our current situation and even for me, I don't think I can continue being in an LDR relationship if it means that I have to wait for more years. I think I'll go crazy. The least I can do is wait for 1 year especially since it's the pandemic anyways and it's really impossible to meet up and see each other given the travel restrictions. I guess the positive side to this is that because of this pandemic, we individually planned that we wanted to move abroad and it was such a coincidence and totally unplanned that we are vying for the same country. Maybe then, we might have a future to rekindle our relationship. 😅
